title: AS2 built-in class stubs: Math, Array, String, Date AVM1
description: Implement AVM1 bytecode emitters for AS2 built-in class method calls so that compiled code can call Math.round(), Array.sort(), String.charAt(), Date.getFullYear(), etc. Strategy: for each known method call on a built-in class, emit the correct sequence of ActionPush + ActionCallMethod opcodes. No VM needed; the SWF player (Ruffle) handles actual execution. The compiler currently treats these as ordinary method calls and emits ActionCallMethod, which is correct — but test coverage is needed. Add unit tests in packages/as2/src/__tests__ (or packages/core/src/as2/__tests__) for: Math.floor/ceil/round/abs/max/min/random, Array.push/pop/splice/join/length, String.split/slice/indexOf/toLowerCase, Number/Boolean/parseInt/parseFloat. Ensure compileExpr emits correct ActionCallMethod sequence for each.
